_note: features kit (2026-10-15). Studio coords; each piece authored at its pivot then slid along +X (pivot_studio). Import 3D with Insert Using Scene Position (group Gunsy Funsy); per piece: Model from its meshes, PivotOffset/CFrame = pivot_studio; mesh CFrame = pivot + center_rel_pivot. Front = -Z (Roblox Front face). K_Scale5 10-stud cube at (0,120,0), K_Marker5 long arm +X, upright +Y, short arm +Z.

F_TVArmWall.mount: wall: back plate at z 0 (wall face), TV faces -Z

F_TVArmCeil.mount: ceiling: plate top at y 0 (ceiling face), TV hangs below, faces -Z

F_TVArmCeilDual.mount: ceiling: plate top at y 0 (ceiling face), TV hangs below, two screens back to back (Front and Back)

F_Container20.mount: floor: bottom at y 0, doors at +X
F_Container20.colours: olive drab 88,98,58 (default) / sage 167,173,152 / warm grey 200,196,186 / near-black 40,42,38

F_Container10.mount: floor: bottom at y 0, doors at +X
F_Container10.colours: olive drab 88,98,58 (default) / sage 167,173,152 / warm grey 200,196,186 / near-black 40,42,38

F_PipeStraight.mount: pipe axis = X through the origin, length 8, ports at x -4 / +4, r 0.45 (flanges r 0.63)

F_PipeElbow.mount: port A at (-0.85, 0, 0) facing -X, port B at (1.5, 2.35, 0) facing +Y; bend radius 1.5 in the XY plane

F_PipeValve.mount: pipe axis = X, length 5, ports at x -2.5 / +2.5; handwheel up (+Y)

F_PipeRun.mount: wall: brackets at z 0, two pipes at z -1 (y 0 and 1.3), length 16 along X (ports x -8 / +8)

F_PowerBox.mount: wall: back at z 0, faces -Z, centre at y 0 (box y -2.2..2.2); conduit to y 4.5

F_JunctionBox.mount: wall: back at z 0, faces -Z; conduit stubs to y +-1.6

F_Intercom.mount: wall: back at z 0, faces -Z, centre at y 0 (mount ~5 studs up)

F_RewardStand.mount: floor: bottom at y 0; display top flat at y 3.5 (r 1.9); spin the reward model at (0, 6, 0) with the LobbySpin tag; halo ring r 1.9 at y 7.6; name plate faces -Z

F_PitRim.mount: floor: hole 10 x 10 centred on the origin, floor top y 0; rim 12 x 12 (top y 0.04, hazard 0.08); shaft to y -8 (void bottom). Cut a 10 x 10 hole in the floor; put the teleporter From part inside the shaft (e.g. y -6, 10 x 2 x 10).

F_TrussSpot.mount: clamps on a horizontal tube along X (axis through the origin, tube r 0.3); can aims -Y; rotate about X/Z to aim. SpotLight on the lens mesh (Face Bottom): 255,241,208, brightness 1.5-2.5, range 30-60, shadows on 1-2 only

F_Truss10.mount: square box truss 1.2 x 1.2, length 10 along X, chords r 0.12 at y/z +-0.6 (chords are where F_TrussSpot clamps; its tube r 0.3 clamp also fits)

F_BeaconMast.mount: floor / roof: base at y 0, 12-stud mast, lens dome at y 12.55-13.3; PointLight in the lens (amber 255,170,40 or red 220,40,40), slow pulse

F_BeaconWall.mount: wall: back at z 0; arm out 1 stud (-Z), lens dome at (0, 0.7..1.43, -1)

F_HoloEmitter.mount: floor: base at y 0, emitter top at y 0.93; hologram / model centred at (0, 3.5, 0); holo_cone mesh optional (Transparency 0.85, or replace with a Beam); sparkles on the lens attachment

F_SwapBin.mount: floor: bottom at y 0, front plate faces -Z (the old script points -Z at the room centre with CFrame.lookAt)
